mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which potentiates nifedipine's hypotensive effects and increases risk of cardiac arrhythmias; nifedipine may increase amphotericin B nephrotoxicity through renal hemodynamic changes.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; supplement electrolytes aggressively; adjust nifedipine dose if hypotension develops.
